question: What is the purpose of the fine-tuning process described in this chart?
model_answer: Based on the chart, the purpose of the fine-tuning process is to adapt a general base model (Mistralv0.2-Base) to specific medical domains. This domain adaptation improves the model's ability to understand and generate specialized vocabulary, as evidenced by the fine-tuned models (orange/brown bars) consistently assigning higher probabilities (less negative log probabilities) to medical terms compared to the base model (blue bars).
